cards.name: mcx_and_tree_resynthesis
cards.identity: Recognize, by exact symbolic Boolean simulation of a Toffoli-level segment, that it implements a multi-controlled X: t ^= c1 & c2 & ... & ck (every other wire returns to its initial value, ancillas 0 -> 0). Discard the whole recognized segment and re-emit the same function as Gidney's temporary-logical-AND ladder/tree over k-1 CLEAN ancillas: b1 = and_compute(c1,c2); b2 = and_compute(b1,c3); ...; b_{k-1} = and_compute(b_{k-2},ck); cx(b_{k-1}, t); then and_uncompute(b_{k-1}), ..., and_uncompute(b1) in reverse order. Each and_compute is the 4-T |0>-initialized AND gadget (T,T,T,Tdg-style Toffoli-into-fresh-ancilla); each and_uncompute is H + Z-basis measurement on the ancilla with a classically controlled CZ fix-up on its two inputs, costing 0 T. A balanced binary tree (b = and_compute of pairs, then pairs of partial ANDs) is an equally valid emission with the same gadget count and lower depth; use the ladder when ancilla count is the tie-break, the tree when depth is.
cards.correctness: and_compute(x,y -> a) on a clean ancilla is the standard 4-T measurement-uncomputable AND: it maps |x>|y>|0> to |x>|y>|x&y> exactly (no relative phase after the Tdg correction in Gidney's gadget), so the ladder leaves b_{k-1} = c1&...&ck by induction (b1 = c1&c2; b_i = b_{i-1}&c_{i+1} = c1&...&c_{i+1}), and cx(b_{k-1}, t) sets t ^= AND(controls). and_uncompute measures the ancilla in the X basis after H; the outcome m is uniformly random and independent of the data, and conditioned on m the residual operator on the two input wires is CZ^m, which the classically controlled CZ cancels. Hence for every measurement branch m the branch Kraus operator is K_m |x> = c_m |f(x)> with c_m = 2^{-1/2} independent of x (phase consistency, invariant 2), and sum_m |c_m|^2 = 1. Ancillas are returned to |0> (post-measurement reset by the classically controlled X on m, standard in the gadget). The function f is identical to the recognized segment's by construction, and recognition itself is exact: h-ccz-h on the target is ccx, so the segment is a classical reversible Toffoli network; propagating Boolean expressions (ancillas initialized to the constant 0) and canonicalizing them (BDD or sympy simplify_logic over the k+1 non-ancilla variables) decides wire-by-wire that the output map is exactly t ^= AND(c1..ck) with all other wires identity. No approximation: 0 charged to the error budget.
cards.trigger: A maximal segment of the op list containing only {ccz, ccx, cx, x, h} in which every h occurs as part of an h-ccz-h sandwich on one leg of a ccz (so the segment is equivalent to a pure ccx/cx/x network). Run symbolic Boolean simulation with ancilla wires (wires never read before first write, and written back to 0 at the end) set to constant 0 and all other wires set to free variables. Fire iff the canonicalized output assignment is: exactly one wire q_t has value v_t XOR (AND over a set S of >= 4 other wires), every wire in S is unchanged, and every remaining wire is unchanged (ancillas back to constant 0). The match records (q_t, S). On mcx_10 the whole 66-gate circuit is one such segment, giving q_t = the target and |S| = 10. Does not fire on adders/multipliers (their outputs are XOR-of-many-products, not a single full AND), and does not fire on segments with fewer than 4 controls (where the existing book rule is already optimal).
cards.expected_effect: All 32 ccz and all 34 h gates of mcx_10 disappear. They are replaced by 9 and_compute gadgets (4 T each = 36 T), 1 cx, and 9 zero-T measured and_uncomputes. The input is Barenco et al.'s 4(n-2) = 32-Toffoli borrowed-ancilla MCX, which pays 4 Toffolis per control because it must restore DIRTY ancillas; since the harness guarantees ancillas start in |0>, the restoration work is pure waste. T-count 128 -> 36 (below pyzx's 100 and TKET's 192). Qubit count 19 -> 20 (9 ancillas instead of 8); T is the first lexicographic key so this is a win, and the balanced-tree emission uses the same 9. On other reconstruction circuits in the suite the trigger does not fire, so no regression.
cards.source: C. Gidney, 'Halving the cost of quantum addition', Quantum 2, 74 (2018), arXiv:1709.06648 (temporary logical-AND: 4 T to compute, 0 T measurement-based uncompute); the replaced structure is Barenco, Bennett, Cleve, DiVincenzo, Margolus, Shor, Sleator, Smolin, Weinfurter, PRA 52, 3457 (1995), Lemma 7.2 (4(n-2) Toffolis with borrowed ancillas); AND-ladder MCX cost 4n-4 T as in Jones, PRA 87, 022328 (2013) and Maslov, PRA 93, 022311 (2016).
